Alchimie instable : Lorsque vous prépare:
Unstable Alchemy: When you prepare a potion, choose its mode of use, then roll 1d6 to determine the quality of its preparation.

1 — Catastrophe: The potion produces a negative or counter-productive effect.

2 — Failure: The potion produces no useful effect.

3 — Minor Effect: The potion produces a reduced effect: 2d6 damage, 2d6 healing, or +Spirit Mod damage on an imbued weapon, for example.

4 — Useful Effect: The potion grants a tactical advantage, such as slowing a target or granting Advantage on attack rolls.

5 — Major Effect: The potion produces a powerful effect of damage or control.

6 — Masterpiece: The potion produces an exceptional effect capable of changing the course of combat.

Alchemical DNA: If you have captured a creature's DNA, that creature suffers Disadvantage on saving throws against your potions.

Alchemical Combination: You can combine up to 4 effects in the same potion by discarding cards of different suits.

Preparation and Use: You can use a potion during its preparation, without waiting for it to be finished.
Bloquer des cartes pour copier une capac: Lock cards to copy an ability. Lock a value equivalent to the ability's cost after reduction by your stats and neutral suit. If the target is an ally, the copy is direct. If the target is an enemy, you must make an Investigation roll to copy it; the cost as well as the values of the ability depend on the result. Unlock the cards using the ability.
Bloquez une carte et effectuez un d100 ≤:
Lock a card and perform a d100 ≤ 7 × card to determine if you are Angry/Feared or Happy/Sad.
Fear ↔ Anger

Trigger: when you take damage.

Fear — Negative: +1 reaction. Disadvantage on attack and ability rolls.

Anger — Positive: Advantage on attack and ability rolls.

Switch Fear → Anger: Draw 1 card. Maximum: Spirit Mod / 2 times per round.

Sad ↔ Happy

Trigger: when you deal damage.

Sad — Negative: Disadvantage on saving throws. Attacks against you have advantage. During an interaction with a creature, that creature makes an Insight saving throw against your Spirit to prevent the condition from spreading.

Happy — Positive: Automatic channeling on all suits.

Switch Sad → Happy: Gain 1 bonus action. Maximum: Spirit Mod / 2 times per round.

Apocalypse: Make both switches during the same turn. On success, combine all positive effects of the dualities without their negative effects for the rest of the combat and unlock your cards.
Bloquez une carte. Chaque fois que vous:
Block a card. Each time you take an attack, gain 1 charge, up to a maximum equal to your Spirit modifier (3). You can consume these charges when activating your abilities to gain a bonus based on the blocked card's suit; you can stack multiple cards:

♦ Diamonds: Increase damage by your Spirit Mod per charge consumed.

♥ Hearts: Recover 0.5 × Spirit Mod d6 HP per charge consumed.

♣ Clubs: Increase your ability range by 3 m per charge consumed.

♠ Spades: Increase your speed and forced movements by your Spirit Mod per charge consumed.

Being on a horse grants Advantage on attack rolls, but makes Acrobatics saves impossible.
Invoquez Mod Esprit oiseaux de papier qu:
Summon a number of paper birds equal to your Spirit Mod. You can bind them to yourself or your allies.

Each creature accompanied by a guide bird gains Advantage on all saving throws, has its movement speed multiplied by 1.5, ignores difficult terrain and is immune to Blindness.

You can also send your birds up to 100 m to deliver messages, or make an Arcana check for them to guide you to a destination.
